decisions.decision: Compatibility-only changes; preserve base performance behavior. Never fabricate audit, boot or hardware verification.
Use repository secrets for all credentials, including continuation authentication. First heavy job mirrors stock.

Initial run 41253531553 mirrored the base asset but failed state pushes because provisioning code advanced main concurrently. Implemented bounded fetch/rebase/push retries and base-manifest recovery; rerun latest workflow without re-downloading the verified base asset.

No speculative stock HAL/VINTF/SELinux transplant or performance modification. Do not label unchanged input as patched. Unsupported stock containers and unavailable matched ARM64 emulator artifacts are explicit blockers.

Provisioning verified the uploaded 1,313,731,068-byte base asset against its upstream SHA-256 and recovered its manifest without another image download. Stock mirror remains in the active Actions run.

Existing public repository and complete 6,512,327,514-byte stock mirror found; resumed rather than recreating or re-downloading Drive. Telegram repository secrets and continuation secret were securely provisioned; notification succeeded.

Previous base audit had PermissionError on four root-owned 0600 init/property files, preventing API verification. Added privileged read-only inventory worker without changing any source permissions. Corrected v2 base audit now has zero extraction errors and confirms AxionOS Android 16 API 36/SDK-full 36.1.

Stock ZIP has both Firmware/Open/super.img and Firmware/super.img. Selecting first ZIP entry used the wrong optional image. Canonical extraction now ranks scatter-adjacent Firmware/super.img first; old evidence is retained separately, not silently reused. Includes tr_product hardware inventory where extractable.

Corrected Android Build discovery to official https://androidbuild-pa.googleapis.com/v4/. Verified build 16644040 is Android 17/API 37 and rejected it. Verified official build 14981173 is Android 16/API 36.1 ARM64; added matching host/images mirror bootstrap with MD5 and SHA-256 pinning. Public client key and signed URLs remain process-only.

Use matching x86_64 Cuttlefish host package and explicit ARM64 QEMU TCG guest on free ubuntu-24.04. Native ARM64 Cuttlefish on hosts without KVM cannot reliably disable its hardcoded native KVM path. This changes the test harness only, not ROM performance or device configuration.

Telegram transport now delivers every uploaded screenshot as a photo and key logs/report files as documents, records content-hash receipts, and reconciles unsent screenshots from earlier sessions. Blocked stage retries have six-hour backoff rather than being cached forever.
